subject.title: [UX/Bug] Model selection array order is strictly bound to checkbox ticking sequence, causing unintended primary/fallback assignment

question: Should this report be transferred or recreated for the OpenClaw runtime/configuration code, kept in ClawHub only if there is a concrete registry/CLI integration gap, or closed as out-of-repo support?
rationale: The report is concrete and VISION-aligned, but the affected model picker, config persistence, and WebSocket synchronization implementation is not present in the ClawHub checkout, so automation cannot choose the repository/product routing safely.

options.title: Transfer to runtime repo
options.body: Move or recreate the report where the `openclaw configure` model picker and Web UI config-sync code live, then fix deterministic role persistence there.

options.title: Keep only with ClawHub gap
options.body: Keep this issue in ClawHub only if maintainers identify a specific registry/package/CLI integration behavior that contributes to the model selection conflict.

options.title: Close as out-of-repo support
options.body: Close this ClawHub issue if maintainers decide the report belongs entirely outside this repository and no transfer/tracking action is needed.

recommendation.title: Transfer to runtime repo
recommendation.body: Move or recreate the report where the `openclaw configure` model picker and Web UI config-sync code live, then fix deterministic role persistence there.

likelyOwner.reason: Patrick is the only evidence-backed adjacent owner from the current ClawHub history for CLI/config scope and product routing context.
